messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGER: High error rate detected - infer-runtime in us-east-1 for model-7b-v2. 502/5xx spike to ~11% above baseline. Paging @eng-oncall.

eng-oncall: ack — looking. any initial customer impact notes?

mike_lee: seeing gateway timeouts -> 502s from model-runner. Traces point to segfaults on model-host-12 and OOM killer entries. Spike started ~09:12 UTC.

jess_ops: customer reports: 2 large tenants seeing increased latency and dropped requests. errors occur under longer sequences (>512).

eng-oncall: I'm going to cordon model-host-12 and drain. @ops_lead can you prepare reroute to spare pool and stand by for rollback if needed?

ops_lead: on it — starting drain of host-12, prepping spare pool (scaling +2 GPU nodes). ETA ~3m.

mike_lee: grabbing logs from host-12 now. snippet:
```text
[09:13:22 UTC] model-runner[pid=1423]: segfault at 0x7f... (attention_kern.c:0x4f)
[09:13:23 UTC] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1423 (model-runner) total-vm: 12G, anon-rss:10G
[09:13:23 UTC] systemd: model-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```

jess_ops: stack looks like NV kernels OOM then immediate segfault in quant-attention path. suspect quant kernel regression or KVCACHE growth on longseqs.

eng-oncall: mitigation steps I propose:
1) Reroute ~60% traffic from us-east-1 -> us-west-2 (canary shift)
2) Cordon host-12 + restart runner with non-quant kernels on the host
3) Pause model-7b-v2 quant rollout and enable fallback model-7b-v1 for heavy requests
4) Promote hotfix to canary if stable

ops_lead: traffic reroute started, LB rule applied, ~60% now to us-west-2. Confirming metrics streaming.

mike_lee: I built a non-quant kernel build and ran load on a test host — no crashes so far at 2x traffic. Pushing hotfix to canary now.

eng-oncall: can someone run a quick smoke against canary? e.g. `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"model-7b-v2","input":"hello"}'`

jess_ops: smoke OK on canary — 200 responses, p50 ~120ms, no 5xx.

eng-oncall: good. rolling back quant rollout and marking rollout paused. keeping traffic routed while we monitor.

incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED:
- host-12 cordoned/drained
- trafffic ~60% shifted to us-west-2
- quant rollout paused for model-7b-v2
- non-quant hotfix promoted to canary
- postmortem owner: @mike_lee
- next update ETA in 20m
:hammer_and_wrench:

mike_lee: filing incident ticket with logs/traces and tagging product-impact + cust-sre. Will attach heap/profile and nvml logs.

eng-oncall: thanks all — staying on until external error rate < 1.5% and affected hosts stable. Will post RCA follow-up in #postmortems.
